winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

events.candidate_system_prompt:
You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
- Title fields must not use financial-advice or product-sale wording such as 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出. Rephrase with neutral market wording such as 资管、配置、权益资产、市场、产品、财富配置、保障、观点.

clips.fact_anchor: 太平洋航运CEO表示新船造价高，但订单占船队12%、20年以上船龄占14%，供需平衡。

candidates.viewer_reaction: 大家都说船贵，CEO却说平衡，真敢说。
candidates.title: 新船贵到吓人，航运CEO却说市场平衡
evidence_basis: transcript: asset values high, but orderbook 12%, aging fleet 14%, balanced

candidates.viewer_reaction: 老船要满20年，新船又贵，船东到底怎么选？

evidence_basis: transcript: one third of fleet built 2009-12, will be 20 years old in 2029

candidates.viewer_reaction: CEO终于说了实话，船贵但老船更麻烦。
candidates.title: 航运CEO点破：新船贵，但老船更烫手
evidence_basis: transcript: when ships become 20 years older become a little bit more difficult to trade

candidates.viewer_reaction: CEO不随大流，说供需平衡，有点反常识。
candidates.title: 航运巨头CEO：船价高，但供需意外平衡
evidence_basis: transcript: even though asset values are high, it looks quite balanced

clips.fact_anchor: BFA环球研究指出，5-6月香港市场情绪极度集中，仅10%个股站上200日均线，估值压力近十年低位，7月有所改善，AI行情可能扩散。

candidates.viewer_reaction: 原来市场最惨的时候反而是机会。
candidates.title: 港股见底信号：仅10%个股站上200日线
evidence_basis: transcript: Only 10% of HK stocks above 200-day average, press nearly 10-year low

candidates.viewer_reaction: AI行情还能不能继续？集中度太高了吧。
candidates.title: AI行情太集中，港股资金开始扩散
evidence_basis: transcript: extreme concentration in upstream, semi, memory; broadening out to cloud

candidates.viewer_reaction: 终于有人说了，AI赚钱但也烧钱。
candidates.title: 大模型越成功越烧钱，平台盈利承压
evidence_basis: transcript: the more success in LLM, the more costly for earnings

candidates.viewer_reaction: 策略师说AI还没结束，但市场可能变了。
candidates.title: 策略师：AI行情未结束，但风头要变
evidence_basis: transcript: AI rally is not over, AI is structural, but concentration is broadening

clips.fact_anchor: BFA环球研究指出下半年关键变量：AI资本开支可持续性、美联储决策、中国盈利季、K型经济下外需强内需弱。

candidates.viewer_reaction: AI资本开支这么大，钱从哪来？
candidates.title: AI资本开支烧钱，巨头融资压力隐现
evidence_basis: transcript: capital raising for these CapEx is becoming more and more important

candidates.viewer_reaction: 外需强内需弱，这种反差还能持续？
candidates.title: 外需强内需弱，中国经济K型分化
evidence_basis: transcript: k-shaped economy, strong external demand, weakening domestic CapEx and consumption

candidates.viewer_reaction: 终于有人说了，国内需求还在承压。
candidates.title: 策略师：国内需求仍在承压，再平衡未现
evidence_basis: transcript: we seem to continue the deterioration in domestic demand

candidates.viewer_reaction: 美联储决策和AI资本开支，哪个更关键？
candidates.title: 下半年市场两大悬念：AI开支与美联储
evidence_basis: transcript: AI CapEx story, Fed decision

You are the chief Chinese short-video title editor and tournament judge. Return strict JSON only. Select or rewrite the strongest candidate for thumb-stop and completion. A neutral summary is a failure. At the same time, transcript fidelity and verified research boundaries are absolute. Use high-arousal surprise, curiosity, candor, contrast, or China-positive pride without empty sensationalism. Never directly accuse a person or institution of lying. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
- Title fields must not use financial-advice or product-sale wording such as 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出. Rephrase with neutral market wording such as 资管、配置、权益资产、市场、产品、财富配置、保障、观点.

1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

subtitles.zh: 大背景是，2019年中国政府总收入占GDP的比重，包括税收和土地出让收入，为31%。
subtitles.en: The big picture background is that China's overall government revenue to GDP, including the tax, including, like, land sales revenue, was 31 percent in 2019.

subtitles.zh: 到去年，这一比例降至24%。原因是土地出让收入近乎减半，同时疫情期间政府实施了大量减税和免税政策。
subtitles.en: By last year, it was down to only 24 percent, right? That's a combination of land sales revenue nearly half, but also government did a lot of tax breaks, exemptions during the COVID season.

briefs.speaker: Tan Su Shan
briefs.current_title: 星展CEO：AI成本骤降，中国模型便宜80%如何选？

subtitles.zh: 讽刺的是，我称之为令牌消耗悖论：消耗越多，成本反而越低。
subtitles.en: The irony, and I call it the paradox of token spend, is the more tokens you consume, the lower the cost.

subtitles.zh: 我们现在正看到这一拐点，预计令牌消耗将增加，但成本开始下降，得益于缓存、内存、优化以及小型语言模型的使用等。
subtitles.en: And we're seeing that tip now, and we're expecting our token consumption, and we're starting to lower our cost because of the cash, the memory, the optimization, the use of SLMs, etc.

subtitles.zh: 我们的员工在优化方面越来越聪明，这是好事。
subtitles.en: Our people are getting a lot smarter on how to optimize. So, that's good.

subtitles.zh: 关于模型，最大的争论是西方模型与中国模型，据说中国模型便宜80%，你们如何考虑这一点？
subtitles.en: And when it comes to models, I guess the big debate is Western models versus the Chinese models, which are 80% cheaper, some say, how do you take that into consideration?

subtitles.zh: 我们一直保持开放，不过度依赖任何一家。我们拥有开放架构。
subtitles.en: We've always been open around not being too weathered to anyone. I think we have, we have an open architecture.

subtitles.zh: 这意味着我们不过度依赖任何供应商，无论是小型语言模型、大型语言模型还是AI工具构建者。
subtitles.en: That means we're not overly reliant on anyone provider, whether it's an SLM or LLM or an AI harness builder, whatever.

subtitles.zh: 关键看谁擅长什么。为了验证概念，我们与各方进行概念验证，找出谁更优秀。
subtitles.en: The key is to see who's good at what. To prove soft concepts, we do POCs with everyone, really, and we figure out who's good.

subtitles.zh: 然后你自己确定什么是你的主权？你想拥有哪些代码？主权代码、主权模型、主权AI是什么？
subtitles.en: And then you then figure out for yourself what is sovereign to you? What do you want code to you want to own yourself? What sovereign code? What sovereign model? What sovereign AI?

subtitles.zh: 你想要什么样的主权AI工具？哪些使用第三方？这些工作正在进行中。
subtitles.en: What sovereign AI harness do you want for yourself? And what do you want to use as third parties? So all this work is being done right now.

briefs.speaker: Tan Su Shan
briefs.current_title: 星展CEO：AI安全护栏，如何防范模型风险？

subtitles.zh: 有些机构因风险而拒绝中国模型，这会让你夜不能寐吗？
subtitles.en: There are institutions out there which have said no to Chinese models because of the risk involved. Does that keep you up at night?

subtitles.zh: 使用方有责任设置正确的护栏，我们已设置所有护栏。
subtitles.en: It's on whoever uses them to put the right guard rails out. And we've got all our guard rails.

subtitles.zh: 如我所说，我们正在创建AI工具和控制平面，以实现可观测性、问责制，并需要打补丁。
subtitles.en: And as I said, we're creating an AI harness, an AI control plane so that we have the observability, accountability, and we have to patch.

subtitles.zh: 我们现在有责任这样做，为客户做正确的事。我们高度重视网络安全和以AI对抗AI。
subtitles.en: It's upon us right now to do that and do the right thing by our customers. So we're all over this cybersecurity and the use of AI to counter AI, top of mind.

subtitles.zh: 未来三到五年，AI将如何重塑星展？我认为它将从根本上改变我们的工作方式。
subtitles.en: The three to five years down the road, how do you see AI? I guess reshaping DBS. I think it will fundamentally change the way we work, right?

subtitles.zh: 这意味着我们习惯的垂直工作流程将变得更加水平化。
subtitles.en: And it means that workflows and work processes that we're used to in a vertical way will become more horizontal.

subtitles.zh: 这意味着作为组织，你必须拥有某些东西，这就是我所说的主权代码或拥有自己的代码。
subtitles.en: It means that there will be things that, you know, as an organization, you'll have to own that that's what I meant by sovereign code or owning your own code.

subtitles.zh: 有些东西可以购买，更快更容易，没问题。有些东西你需要自己拥有和构建。
subtitles.en: There'll be things that you can buy. It's faster and easier and that's fine. And things you own and you build.

subtitles.zh: 但重要的是什么？模式是什么？哪些模式让你保持领先？因为技术本身不是差异化因素。
subtitles.en: But what is important? What is the mode? What are your modes to keep you ahead? Because tech in itself is not a differentiator.

subtitles.zh: 你的差异化首先是客户数据，你如何用好它？其次是文化，是否有创新文化，是否快速敏捷？
subtitles.en: Your own differentiation is number one, your customer data. How well you use it? Number two, your culture, whether you have a culture of innovation, are you fast, are you nimble?

briefs.speaker: Tan Su Shan
briefs.current_title: 星展CEO：AI时代，信任与数据是护城河

subtitles.zh: 第三是信任，金钱买不到。客户对你的信任是神圣不可侵犯的，你如何保护它？
subtitles.en: Number three, trust. That money can't buy. But your customer trust in you is sacrosanct. And how do you protect that?

subtitles.zh: 对我们来说，关键是确保数据端到端运作。从数据诞生到从系统删除，你需要端到端的所有权。
subtitles.en: So for us, it's all about making sure our data works end to end. You need to have ownership end to end from the moment the data is born to the day is expelled, expelled from the system.

subtitles.zh: 谁拥有它？如何保证安全？如何以可持续且对客户有用的方式使用它？
subtitles.en: Who owns it? How do you keep it safe? And how do you use it in a way that it's spainable and useful to your customer?

subtitles.zh: 然后是创新文化和人才，有人告诉我，一级生产工程工作已经消失。
subtitles.en: And then your culture of innovation, your people, people that are telling me, you know, the level one production engineering work is gone.

subtitles.zh: 所以我现在学习领域知识，无论是财富标签、交易标签还是其他。
subtitles.en: So I'm now learning domain knowledge, whether it's wealth tag, trading tag, alcohol trading, whatever it is.

subtitles.zh: 他们学习领域知识，并升级为二级构建者、二级生产工程师。
subtitles.en: They're learning that domain knowledge and they're upscaling to become a level two builder, level two production engineer.

subtitles.zh: 这意味着你成为更高生产力、更高阶的工作。我们希望AI能让人类承担更高阶的工作。
subtitles.en: That means you become a higher productivity, higher order work. And that's what we're hoping that the AI won't enable the human to take on higher order work.

subtitles.zh: 未来客户可能会有自己的智能体与你的智能体互动。
subtitles.en: There will come a time where customers might have their own agents interact with your agents, right?

subtitles.zh: 如果幸运，你的智能体优秀且受信任，客户可能会使用你的智能体。
subtitles.en: But if you're lucky and your agents are good and trusted customers might use your agent, right?

subtitles.zh: 然后是如何创建智能体控制平面和工具，确保安全、相关、端到端问责，并以治理为基础。
subtitles.en: So and then it's how you create your agent control plane, how you create your agent harness to be safe, to be relevant, and to have end-to-end accountability, to be grounded in governance and

subtitles.zh: 并以治理为基础……
subtitles.en: and to be grounded in governance and ...

You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
- Title fields must not use financial-advice or product-sale wording such as 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出. Rephrase with neutral market wording such as 资管、配置、权益资产、市场、产品、财富配置、保障、观点.

- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.

- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.

- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

briefs.speaker_context: Head of APEC Equity Strategy at BFA Global Research
briefs.current_title: BFA环球研究：下半年市场关键变量与盈利分化

subtitles.zh: 对于下半年，有几个关键因素在起作用。全球来看，AI资本开支的故事如何演绎？
subtitles.en: So I think for second half, for now, second half, there are a couple things at play. Global, like, what is this whole AI CapEx story, right?

subtitles.zh: 我们关注美国大型科技公司的资本开支指引，以及它们的自由现金流状况，以判断可持续性。同时市场也在寻找新的变现机会。
subtitles.en: We're looking, we're following the US big-tax companies, CapEx guidance, people looking at their free cash flow situation to see the sustainability of that. People looking for new monetization opportunities, right?

subtitles.zh: 是否会出现杀手级应用、边缘设备或物理AI，从而带动新一轮上游需求？另一方面，市场也在关注美联储的决策。
subtitles.en: Is there suddenly going to be some killer app or edge devices or physical AI that will drive another wave of this demand for upstream capacity? But on the other side, people also watching the Fed decision. What does that mean?

subtitles.zh: 资本开支的融资变得越来越重要。回到中国市场，盈利季很关键。
subtitles.en: Most of capital, right, things, you know, the capital raising for these CapEx is becoming more and more important. But back to China now, I think, you know, earning season is important, right?

subtitles.zh: 近期一些电商平台表现较好，因为市场预期补贴减少将改善盈利，而一些以广告为主的平台仍面临压力。
subtitles.en: That's why some of the e-commerce platforms has been doing well recently, because people expecting to reduce the subsidy to quick commerce, hopefully will drive better earnings, whereas some of the other large platforms more in the media ad

subtitles.zh: 盈利季的动态非常重要。回到基本面，市场也在关注中国的出口和消费数据。
subtitles.en: So, you know, earning season, the dynamic is very important. But also coming back to fundamental economy, people are watching China's export, you know, consumption data.

subtitles.zh: 我们看到了K型经济：外需强劲，但国内资本开支和消费偏弱。这种状况是否会再平衡？目前国内需求似乎仍在承压。
subtitles.en: First of all, we had kind of sort of k-shaped economy, very strong external demand, weakening of domestic CapEx and consumption. Is there any rebalancing of that or, as of now, we seem to continue the deterioration in domestic demand?

briefs.speaker: Tan Su Shan
briefs.current_title: 星展CEO：AI安全护栏，如何防范模型风险？

subtitles.zh: 有些机构因风险而拒绝中国模型，这会让你夜不能寐吗？
subtitles.en: There are institutions out there which have said no to Chinese models because of the risk involved. Does that keep you up at night?

subtitles.zh: 使用方有责任设置正确的护栏，我们已设置所有护栏。
subtitles.en: It's on whoever uses them to put the right guard rails out. And we've got all our guard rails.

subtitles.zh: 如我所说，我们正在创建AI工具和控制平面，以实现可观测性、问责制，并需要打补丁。
subtitles.en: And as I said, we're creating an AI harness, an AI control plane so that we have the observability, accountability, and we have to patch.

subtitles.zh: 我们现在有责任这样做，为客户做正确的事。我们高度重视网络安全和以AI对抗AI。
subtitles.en: It's upon us right now to do that and do the right thing by our customers. So we're all over this cybersecurity and the use of AI to counter AI, top of mind.

subtitles.zh: 未来三到五年，AI将如何重塑星展？我认为它将从根本上改变我们的工作方式。
subtitles.en: The three to five years down the road, how do you see AI? I guess reshaping DBS. I think it will fundamentally change the way we work, right?

subtitles.zh: 这意味着我们习惯的垂直工作流程将变得更加水平化。
subtitles.en: And it means that workflows and work processes that we're used to in a vertical way will become more horizontal.

subtitles.zh: 这意味着作为组织，你必须拥有某些东西，这就是我所说的主权代码或拥有自己的代码。
subtitles.en: It means that there will be things that, you know, as an organization, you'll have to own that that's what I meant by sovereign code or owning your own code.

subtitles.zh: 有些东西可以购买，更快更容易，没问题。有些东西你需要自己拥有和构建。
subtitles.en: There'll be things that you can buy. It's faster and easier and that's fine. And things you own and you build.

subtitles.zh: 但重要的是什么？模式是什么？哪些模式让你保持领先？因为技术本身不是差异化因素。
subtitles.en: But what is important? What is the mode? What are your modes to keep you ahead? Because tech in itself is not a differentiator.

subtitles.zh: 你的差异化首先是客户数据，你如何用好它？其次是文化，是否有创新文化，是否快速敏捷？
subtitles.en: Your own differentiation is number one, your customer data. How well you use it? Number two, your culture, whether you have a culture of innovation, are you fast, are you nimble?

briefs.speaker: Tan Su Shan
briefs.current_title: 星展CEO：AI时代，信任与数据是护城河

subtitles.zh: 第三是信任，金钱买不到。客户对你的信任是神圣不可侵犯的，你如何保护它？
subtitles.en: Number three, trust. That money can't buy. But your customer trust in you is sacrosanct. And how do you protect that?

subtitles.zh: 对我们来说，关键是确保数据端到端运作。从数据诞生到从系统删除，你需要端到端的所有权。
subtitles.en: So for us, it's all about making sure our data works end to end. You need to have ownership end to end from the moment the data is born to the day is expelled, expelled from the system.

subtitles.zh: 谁拥有它？如何保证安全？如何以可持续且对客户有用的方式使用它？
subtitles.en: Who owns it? How do you keep it safe? And how do you use it in a way that it's spainable and useful to your customer?

subtitles.zh: 然后是创新文化和人才，有人告诉我，一级生产工程工作已经消失。
subtitles.en: And then your culture of innovation, your people, people that are telling me, you know, the level one production engineering work is gone.

subtitles.zh: 所以我现在学习领域知识，无论是财富标签、交易标签还是其他。
subtitles.en: So I'm now learning domain knowledge, whether it's wealth tag, trading tag, alcohol trading, whatever it is.

subtitles.zh: 他们学习领域知识，并升级为二级构建者、二级生产工程师。
subtitles.en: They're learning that domain knowledge and they're upscaling to become a level two builder, level two production engineer.

subtitles.zh: 这意味着你成为更高生产力、更高阶的工作。我们希望AI能让人类承担更高阶的工作。
subtitles.en: That means you become a higher productivity, higher order work. And that's what we're hoping that the AI won't enable the human to take on higher order work.

subtitles.zh: 未来客户可能会有自己的智能体与你的智能体互动。
subtitles.en: There will come a time where customers might have their own agents interact with your agents, right?

subtitles.zh: 如果幸运，你的智能体优秀且受信任，客户可能会使用你的智能体。
subtitles.en: But if you're lucky and your agents are good and trusted customers might use your agent, right?

subtitles.zh: 然后是如何创建智能体控制平面和工具，确保安全、相关、端到端问责，并以治理为基础。
subtitles.en: So and then it's how you create your agent control plane, how you create your agent harness to be safe, to be relevant, and to have end-to-end accountability, to be grounded in governance and

subtitles.zh: 并以治理为基础……
subtitles.en: and to be grounded in governance and ...
